title: Comunicación, formularios, consentimientos y seguimiento básico
mergePolicy: No merge; independent review required from Claude and Antigravity on exact head SHA.

permissionPolicy.reviewHistory: append-only; decision/note linked to answer, assignment, version, actor and timestamp; notes excluded from audit/log payloads

areas.communication: One center-client conversation, staff/client messages, read/unread, manual unread, templates, separate internal notes, transaction-backed audit and idempotency.
areas.forms: Draft/active/archived forms, immutable versions and responses, per-client assignments, validated answers, PAR-Q manual review only.
areas.consents: Version hashes, immutable acceptance snapshots, client acceptance and separately authorized staff-assisted acceptance.
areas.documentsAndBooking: Center/client/service/plan requirements checked for new bookings only; actionable missing-document response; audited override; waitlist and existing cancellations remain compatible.
areas.followup: Per-client check-in assignment, due/overdue state, history, and sensitive response gating. No medical inference.
areas.client360: Unread, required form/consent, review and overdue check-in indicators; messages/documents/follow-up links and panels.
